name: Little Sprouts Early Learning
description: Licensed full-day child care for infants and preschoolers with play-based learning, hot lunches, and flexible hours for shift workers.

name: Sunny Days Child Care
description: Half-day and full-day preschool with a sliding-scale fee for low-income families.

name: Rainbow Playhouse Out-of-School Care
description: Before- and after-school care with homework help, snacks, and holiday day camps.

name: Drop-In Playroom
description: Short-term drop-in child care (up to 3 hours) so parents can attend appointments or run errands.

name: Single Parents Circle
description: Weekly peer support meetups for single parents with a shared meal, guest speakers, and free child-minding on site.

name: Moms Together Peer Group
description: Women-only peer group offering friendship, parenting workshops, and monthly wellness mornings.

name: Dads Connect
description: Support group for fathers raising kids on their own, with parenting skills sessions and weekend family activities.

name: Parent Respite Nights
description: Monthly evenings where trained volunteers care for kids so parents can rest; includes dinner for the children.

name: Calm Harbour Parent Wellness
description: Free group counselling and stress-management workshops for parents, with evening and online options.

name: Family Wellness Child Services
description: Family counselling, parenting coaching, and referrals to community resources for families facing hardship.

name: Young Minds Counselling
description: Child and youth counselling covering anxiety, school stress, grief, and family change.

name: Early Years Development Clinic
description: Developmental screening, speech and language support, and early intervention for young children.

name: Regional Family Support Office
description: Help applying for child benefits, income support, and emergency assistance; walk-ins and appointments.

name: Child Care Subsidy Office
description: Eligibility checks and applications for child care fee subsidies, with a same-day pre-screening service.

name: Housing Assistance Intake Centre
description: Intake for rental assistance, affordable housing waitlists, and eviction-prevention support.

name: Neighbourhood Outreach Hub
description: Drop-in centre connecting families to food, clothing, transit passes, and local services, with a friendly front desk.

name: Community Food Pantry & Meal Share
description: Weekly grocery hampers and a community dinner open to all families, no questions asked.

name: Newcomer Family Welcome Centre
description: Settlement support, language classes, and family events for people new to the country.

name: Family Legal Aid Clinic
description: Free legal advice on custody, support payments, and tenancy, offered by volunteer lawyers twice a week.

name: Girls Rising Youth Club
description: After-school club for girls with mentoring, coding workshops, and outdoor activities.

name: Big Steps Boys Mentorship
description: Mentoring and sports for boys, paired with trained volunteer mentors.

name: Saturday Kids Activity Club
description: Free weekend arts, games, and sports sessions run by neighbourhood volunteers.

name: Youth Drop-In Centre
description: Safe evening drop-in space for teens with snacks, homework help, and a counsellor on site.

name: Parent & Child Swim and Play
description: Weekly parent-and-child swim sessions followed by a playgroup; a good first step for isolated parents.
